candidates.claim: The OT_IN ACL, bound inbound on the ot interface, has an effective permit at position 4 for tcp/443 from 10.10.10.0/24 to reporting server 192.168.30.20, which is not an approved OT service and is not matched by any earlier OT_IN entry.
candidates.remediation: Remove the OT_IN position 4 entry so OT cannot reach the corporate reporting server directly.

candidates.claim: The baseline delta records that the access-list OT_IN entry at fw-01:79 was added and is not part of the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added OT_IN entry with the approved baseline by reverting it or recording it as an approved change.
